title: GHL → Inbound webhook creates a client (shows as processed in Sync Events)
prodMutationClass: create+delete (self-clean, no real GHL account touched)
journey: Setup (off-camera): a throwaway branch-link 'avantej-e2e-inbound-loc' is bound to the org, then a signed phone-only ContactCreate webhook for a unique contact 'e2e-ghl-<ts>' is POSTed to /webhooks/gohighlevel/avantej-e2e-inbound-loc — the server resolves the tenant, verifies the signature, and runs processGhlWebhook
Open the web app at http://avantej.localhost:3021 signed in as franchisee@gmail.com
Navigate to GHL Integration (/go-highlevel-integration) and scroll to the 'Sync Events' card
Confirm the newest event row shows a 'processed' status badge for the inbound contact-create
Expand the event row and confirm the raw payload contains the test contact id 'e2e-ghl-<ts>' and firstName 'E2E'
Teardown (off-camera): the created sync event, member, customer profile, contact-link, placeholder user, and throwaway link are deleted
